chapter: Like a Land Where the Tide's Song Surrounds
act_title: Like a Land Where the Tide's Song Surrounds

quests.title: Like a Land Where the Tide's Song Surrounds

dialogue.t: Ah, finally!
My "private singing room" is now ready. I can't thank you enough, {NICKNAME}!
With this shell as the core, I bet my voice will carry even further!
Hehe, don't be silly. Why would I want to prevent people from hearing my lovely voice?
Besides, lots of little animals and lost travelers follow my singing here to take refuge from the wind and snow.
Without my voice to guide the way, how else would they find shelter in such a desolate tundra?

dialogue.sit: I don't even think a person couldn't jump down here...

dialogue.t: True, but they can rest by the cavern, since it gives them cover from the elements anyway.
Plenty of adventurers have been here already! They light campfires and pitch tents by the cavern... Then, they sit there reading strange fairy tales to themselves.

Hmph, what were those tales about again...? Ah, yes. Something about a lost Water Imp hiding out in a cave in the middle of the tundra, constantly singing a sorrowful song because she can't go home...
Plus the usual cliches, like the water imp imprisoning adventurers, or the bottom of the cave being filled with pearls...

dialogue.sit: How did you hear all that?

dialogue.t: No, it was too muffled, so I ran to the bottom of the cavern to listen.
Obviously, that particular adventurer thought no one was in the cave, so it's not like he or his friend were trying to be quiet.
After that... I ran back to this spot and started actually singing a spooky song, and that sure stopped the chatter real quick!
And with the blizzard going on, they couldn't even leave! They had no choice but to listen to me sing all night long... Hehehe.
Too bad this shell wasn't fixed back then, or they would've heard me much more clearly!

dialogue.sit: That would have sent them running for sure...

dialogue.t: Oh, I'd have stopped them. No one's running into terrible weather on my watch...

dialogue.sit: I bet they never would have wanted to leave.

dialogue.t: Hahahaha, of course! They might even have considered themselves lucky to be caught in that blizzard. Not everyone gets to enjoy a private concert from me.
Anyway, enough chit-chat! Time to test this shell's amplification effect.
Cover your ears, okay? I'm going for maximum volume.
*Inhales*

quests.description: Thanks to your hard work, the Tidesong Cavern has finally taken a shape more to Vodyanitsa’s liking…
